EXCLUSIVE RIGHT TO SELL LISTING AGREEMENT

This Exclusive Right to Sell Listing Agreement is made on January 8, 2026 between Ottoline Bramwell-Achebe and Simon Achebe, husband and wife (collectively, "Seller"), and Fairhaven Realty Group, Inc., a licensed Ohio real estate brokerage ("Broker").

1. Property. Seller owns and lists for sale the residential property at 4412 Sycamore Ridge Drive, Worthington, Ohio 43085, Franklin County Parcel No. 100-004821 (the "Property").

2. Exclusive Right to Sell. Seller grants Broker the exclusive right to sell the Property during the Listing Period. Broker earns the commission if the Property is sold, exchanged, or contracted to be sold during the Listing Period by Broker, by Seller, or by any other person.

3. Listing Period. The Listing Period begins on January 8, 2026 and ends at 11:59 p.m. on July 8, 2026, unless extended in a writing signed by both parties. This Agreement does not renew automatically.

4. Listing Price. The Property is listed at $624,900. Seller may change the listing price only in a writing signed by Seller and Broker.

5. Commission. Seller shall pay Broker a commission of six percent (6%) of the gross sale price, due and payable at closing. Broker's compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable between Seller and Broker.

6. Cooperation and Compensation to Other Brokers. Broker may cooperate with and compensate other brokers. Any compensation Broker offers to a buyer's broker is separately negotiated and is disclosed to Seller in writing before Seller accepts an offer.

7. Protection Period. If, within thirty (30) days after the Listing Period ends, Seller sells the Property to a person to whom the Property was shown during the Listing Period and whose name Broker delivered to Seller in writing within five (5) days after the Listing Period ended, Seller shall pay the commission. This does not apply if the Property is listed with another broker at the time of sale.

8. Agency Disclosure. Broker will act as Seller's agent. If a buyer represented by Broker wishes to purchase the Property, Broker will act as a dual agent only with the prior written consent of both Seller and that buyer, and a dual agent may not disclose either party's confidential price information to the other. Seller acknowledges receipt of the Ohio Agency Disclosure Statement.

9. Fair Housing. The Property will be marketed in compliance with federal, state, and local fair housing laws. Broker will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, ancestry, military status, or sexual orientation.

10. Seller Representations. Seller represents that Seller has the authority to sell the Property, that the Property is not subject to another listing agreement, and that Seller has disclosed all known material defects on the Ohio Residential Property Disclosure Form.

11. Marketing Authorization. Seller authorizes Broker to place the Property in the multiple listing service, to install a lockbox and a yard sign, and to photograph the Property for marketing. Seller may opt out of internet display by initialing here: ______.

12. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for the other's material breach on ten (10) days' written notice, after which Broker's authority to market the Property ends and Broker shall remove the listing from the multiple listing service. Section 7 survives termination.

13. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. Any dispute will be heard in the Court of Common Pleas of Franklin County, Ohio.

SELLER: /s/ Ottoline Bramwell-Achebe    /s/ Simon Achebe
BROKER: FAIRHAVEN REALTY GROUP, INC.  By: /s/ Delphine Okoro-Whitaker, Principal Broker
